atoms.name: Coffman conditions
atoms.one_line: Deadlock needs all four: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, circular wait.

atoms.name: Resource allocation graph
atoms.one_line: Request edge process to resource, assignment edge resource to process; single instances: cycle means deadlock; multiple instances: cycle is only necessary.

atoms.name: Prevention, avoidance, detection
atoms.one_line: Prevention breaks one Coffman condition; avoidance (banker) keeps the state safe; detection finds a deadlock afterwards and recovery breaks it.

atoms.name: Safe and unsafe states
atoms.one_line: Safe means some order lets every process finish; unsafe may or may not deadlock; deadlock always means unsafe.

atoms.name: Banker's algorithm
atoms.one_line: Need = Max - Allocation; find a process with Need <= Work, let it finish, add its Allocation to Work; grant a request only if it stays within Need and Available and leaves a safe state.

atoms.name: Deadlock detection and recovery
atoms.one_line: Same loop as the banker but with current Requests instead of Need; unfinished processes are deadlocked; recover by killing processes or preempting resources.

atoms.name: Minimum resources to avoid deadlock
atoms.one_line: Worst case every process holds max - 1 and waits; R >= sum(max_i - 1) + 1 always avoids deadlock.

atoms.name: Lock ordering in code
atoms.one_line: Threads taking locks in different orders can deadlock; one global order removes circular wait; a non-reentrant lock can deadlock a single thread.
